_note: Field centres picked by eye on Google Maps satellite imagery on 14 Nov 2026. Each point is at least 500 m from the field edge. MODIS pixels are 250 m. The page shows the fields in this order. The last five fields come from the Up To Para version (LunarOblivion).

_optional_fields.sow_dates: sowing date per crop as MM-DD, e.g. {"wheat": "05-01", "barley": "05-05"}; crops not listed keep the dates in model/crops.json
_optional_fields.elevation_m: elevation in metres for the air pressure in the evapotranspiration formula; when missing, the elevation of the NASA POWER grid point is used
